Create a production 2D game animation sprite atlas using the attached orange tabby character sheet as the exact identity and hand-painted art style reference. Keep the same honey-orange fur, cream muzzle/chest/paws, amber eyes, forehead M, ringed tail and cute rounded kitten proportions. Actual transparent alpha background. LANDSCAPE 3:2 image. EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 24 evenly sized cells, no gaps, no grid lines, no labels, no background or shadows outside the character. Each cell fully contains one full-body drawing of this SAME kitten, same scale and baseline at 86 percent of cell height, ample transparent margins for tail and ears. Each ROW is a separate continuous six-frame animation from left to right, noticeably different movement each frame, not identical copies. Row 1: sitting idle blink, eye open, half closed, fully closed, half open, open, slight ear twitch. Row 2: walking toward the right, six actual walking leg-cycle poses with alternating front and hind paws, same character location and ground height. Row 3: curled up asleep, six subtle breathing poses with head resting, chest gently rising and falling, eyes closed. Row 4: eating from a little shallow cream food bowl, six frames head lowering, taking a bite, head slightly up chewing, chewing, swallowing, returning down; bowl position fixed. Draw exquisite fine soft short fur and delicate gouache colored-pencil texture, coherent anatomy, clear silhouettes. No texts, no borders, no props except the small bowl in row 4. It is essential all 24 cells align perfectly to a regular 6 by 4 grid and each whole pet is contained within its own cell.
